contamination_risks: Every target warmup, development, and confirmation date-symbol pair was absent from the global exposure index before freeze.
The rejected predecessor contributes adverse history and no promotion evidence.
The complete 32-trial grid is unchanged; no predecessor outcome repaired a parameter.
IWB is feature-only and never contributes a target return.
Confirmation prices remain inaccessible until an exact winner is frozen.
entry_rule: At each completed session, require IWB above the frozen completed SMA, rank the ten Vanguard sector ETFs by completed trailing return, and enter the strongest qualified sector at the next open.

execution_assumptions.expected_gross_proxy: completed sector trailing return minus completed SPY return

exit_rule: Resolve the stop first on daily ambiguity and otherwise exit at the completed close after one or three sessions.
expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-session-open entry, and flat within three sessions.
material_difference_rationale: This changes no signal, parameter, execution, cost, selection, or evidence gate. The equivalent Vanguard sector ETFs and IWB benchmark provide a 1,000-session globally untouched replication of the rejected 120-session SPDR-sector corpus.
mechanism: Own the strongest completed-return U.S. sector ETF relative to a broad-market ETF while that benchmark remains above the same completed trend average.
primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Current complete sector history, quotes, spreads, depth, halts, tradability, timestamps, protection, and reconciliation remain mandatory.
ranking_rule: Rank by highest completed trailing return, tie-break lexically, and admit no more than one new family entry per session.
selection_rule: Require the frozen excess return over IWB and the five-times-cost floor; portfolio risk, contention, entry, and notional caps remain authoritative.
stop_rule: Place the exact 1.0 or 1.5 ATR14 stop below the next open; invalid or missing stops and bars produce rejected or missed trades.

universe_requirements.selection_basis: Ten Vanguard U.S. sector ETFs and broad-market IWB have complete pre-2015 history; every frozen target date pair was globally untouched at freeze.
